answer: Admission auction: each epoch sells only 40 entry slots to the highest bidders, the clearing price hung on a public lantern. Each bid locks a 500 POA deposit: cracking one walnut costs 500, a hundred costs 50,000, so a sybil forging 100 identities pays 50,000 POA while an honest agent pays once and holds the slot for 20 epochs. The auction keeps a steady pulse, one round per epoch, so a flood of fakes only raises the price it must pay.
